verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships an official `bt` CLI with a documented quickstart and command reference. Per the docs, it handles authentication, tracing coding-agent sessions, running evals, browsing and querying logs (`bt view logs`), syncing data (`bt sync pull`) and managing functions. It is explicitly positioned for setting up and running Braintrust alongside a coding agent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as documented.
